entries.title: Dungeon Siege II
entries.definitive_edition: Dungeon Siege II Deluxe Edition when available; otherwise Windows PC release plus separate Broken World

emulation.notes: Use native PC with compatibility notes.

all_releases.reason: primary: documented official platform and required expansion content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Broken World may be missing from current common digital Dungeon Siege II releases, so it must be handled deliberately for completeness.

entries.title: Dungeon Siege: Throne of Agony

all_releases.fidelity: Only documented platform release; PPSSPP provides the best modern capture route.
